maddeler.e:
يتبرنس (form IIq)
# يَتَبَرْنَسُ (yatabarnasu) /ja.ta.bar.na.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَبَرْنَسَ (tabarnasa)
# يُتَبَرْنَسُ (yutabarnasu) /ju.ta.bar.na.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَبَرْنَسَ (tabarnasa)
# يَتَبَرْنَسَ (yatabarnasa) /ja.ta.bar.na.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَبَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
